messages:
anna: Heads-up — noticed a sudden spike in TLS handshake failures from eu-edge around 02:03 UTC after the RBAC change last night. seeing `kms decrypt: access denied` in proxy logs. anyone else?
ram_oncall: I see alerts. paging into logs now. which cluster/namespace?
chris: eu-edge proxies (kube cluster eu-prod, namespace ingress). also seeing the cert-provisioner jobs failing to sign new mTLS certs for service accounts. short log excerpt: 
```
2026-03-23T02:03:12Z cert-provisioner ERROR: provisioner: request failed: KMSDecryptDenied: AccessDenied
\tat kms/unwrap.go:87
\tcause: iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy -> Deny for serviceAccount:cert-issuer-eu@k8s
```
maya: that matches the RBAC prune we applied to kube-system roles (`rbac:restrict-serviceaccounts`) — we scoped down `cert-issuer-eu` SA permissions. maybe we were too tight.
anna: ok rollback plan? can we re-grant kms:Decrypt to that SA quickly?
ram_oncall: I can patch the rolebinding to add kms:Decrypt via the cloud-iam shim. doing `kubectl patch -n kube-system rolebinding cert-issuer-eu -p '{"subjects":[{"kind":"ServiceAccount","name":"cert-issuer-eu","namespace":"kube-system"}]}'` and adding annotation `iam.gke.io/bindings: "projects/.../roles/kms.decrypt"` — will propose change in 2m.
chris: please also check audit logs for 60m before/after to confirm only our RBAC push is correlated. query: `gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.cluster_name="eu-prod" AND textPayload:"KMSDecryptDenied"' --limit 100`
maya: queued a quick rollback on the RBAC PR that removed the clusterrole binding. deploy-bot: scheduled rollback job #4521 triggered (canary=false). :arrow_backward:
deploy-bot: rollback started for rbacs/2026-03-22-pr-9812 T=02:06:15Z
ram_oncall: patch applied to add the kms decrypt binding back. cert-provisioner logs show reattempts and one success at 02:08:40: 
```
2026-03-23T02:08:40Z cert-provisioner INFO: signed certificate for svc=payments-eu; serial=0x4fa3
```
anna: can we confirm mTLS handshake rates recovered? any residual 502/ssl errors at edge?
chris: edge metrics look back to baseline at 02:09. temporary request errors ~2 minutes window. I pulled proxy trace for one failed session: `tls: certificate verify failed: unknown authority` but that was downstream of KMS deny — chain broken because cert not provisioned.
maya: filing follow-up ticket with action items: 1) harden RBAC test harness so cert-provisioner SA perms are validated in PRs, 2) add a preflight audit query to block RBAC PRs that remove `iam:Decrypt` from cert SAs, 3) add a canary delay for RBAC rollouts in eu region. ticket: https://redwood.internal/ops/tickets/INC-2026-782
anna: assign to devex + security for policy gate. ram_oncall — please attach a log digest and timeline to the ticket.
ram_oncall: attaching logs & patch diff now. will follow up with an automated unit test for the RBAC policy. :white_check_mark:
chris: recommend also adding an observability alert that watches consecutive cert provisioning failures > 3 in 5m and ties it to RBAC PRs by author labels.
maya: noted. thanks all — good catch, quick rollback. closing this thread after ticket updated. :lock:
